name: Sun Stride starts its 24 s cooldown on cast and refuses a recast until it elapses (#5247)
contract: Issue #5247 (class 27 Sun Cleric, lvl 15): 'Sun Stride doesn't go on cd, so can only use it once per session.' Spell.dbc 680700 carries RecoveryTime 24000, Category 0, CategoryRecoveryTime 0, StartRecoveryTime 0 -- a plain per-spell cooldown, independent of session. A first cast (with no cooldown-reducing talent learned) must leave Player::GetSpellCooldownDelay(680700) close to 24000 ms and make an immediate second cast fail with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY (67); once that window elapses the cooldown must read 0 again and a third cast must succeed. A missing or desynced cooldown (the reported symptom) would instead let the second cast through immediately with cast_failure 0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no cooldown before the first cast
CONTRACT: casting Sun Stride starts its 24 s cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: a recast while the cooldown is active is refused (fails today if the cooldown never starts: cast_failure stays 0)
CONTRACT: the cooldown clears after 24 s
CONTRACT: a fresh cast after the cooldown elapses succeeds, independent of session
